patch.value: ## Scope\n\nDeliver one production-ready API and release reliability bundle: typed compact registry discovery with optional semantic decoding and filters, complete docs/help/schema/live acceptance, latest managed pm-changelog, and clean-runner publication verification parity. Raw live inventories and credentials remain external and redacted.
Add token-efficient registry discovery and release-runner parity

Expose the official compact entity-registry display contract for agent workflows, preserve full typed and passthrough access, update the managed changelog package, and make tag-driven publication provision the same mandatory verifier toolchain as automatic release preparation.

hassio registries exposes the official compact display endpoint with token-efficient and decoded output, filtering, count, and limit behavior; Full source coverage remains 100/100/100/100, docstrings remain complete, every command help path and every formatter remains valid, and live read-only E2E passes; Tag-driven publish installs every tool required by release:verify, latest pm-changelog generates the canonical changelog, and hosted rehearsal succeeds without publishing a new version
All-status PM lineage, official docs, live endpoint shape, exact failed release logs, current code, and managed package versions reviewed without recording private values
Reduce agent token and bandwidth cost while restoring trustworthy automated release verification.
Agents can query enabled registry metadata efficiently and maintainers can trust the same mandatory gates in preparation and publication.
A reviewed and merged typed discovery surface with reproducible clean-runner release parity.
The official compact endpoint is live but untyped in the CLI, and the latest production tag failed before publication because the publish runner omitted mandatory tools.
